model.name: qwen3.6-35b-a3b
model.about: Alibaba Qwen3.6, mixture of experts (35B, about 3B active), FP8 as published by Qwen. Apache-2.0. Fits an A100 (about 44 GB of 80; FP8 through vLLM's fallback path there). Tests speed against the 27B dense Qwen: far fewer active parameters per token. Thinking off, as for the other Qwen profiles.

answers.sql:
SELECT
    dc.display_name AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction fat
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel dc
    ON fat.channel_key = dc.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON fat.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY dc.display_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dc.business_id) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer dc
WHERE dc.is_current = TRUE
  AND dc.is_active = TRUE;

SELECT
    j.display_name AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert a
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction j
    ON a.jurisdiction_key = j.jurisdiction_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON a.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
    j.display_name
ORDER BY
    alert_count DESC;

SELECT
    b.display_name AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
    ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
    b.display_name
ORDER BY
    transaction_count DESC;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute fcd
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON fcd.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.business_id) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.business_date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer AS c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key
WHERE f.default_flag = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_date = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_day.calendar_date)
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS snapshot_fact
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS snapshot_day ON snapshot_day.date_key = snapshot_fact.business_date_key
    WHERE snapshot_day.calendar_year_number = 2025
      AND snapshot_day.month_number = 8
  );

SELECT
    dcc.display_name AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(fc.complaint_fact_key) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category dcc
    ON fc.complaint_category_key = dcc.complaint_category_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
    ON fc.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY dcc.display_name
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
  c.iso_alpha_code AS currency_code,
  d.calendar_year_number,
  d.calendar_month_number,
  AVG(f.mid_rate) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency c
  ON f.currency_key = c.currency_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
  c.iso_alpha_code,
  d.calendar_year_number,
  d.calendar_month_number
ORDER BY
  c.iso_alpha_code,
  d.calendar_year_number,
  d.calendar_month_number;

SELECT
    m.display_name AS market_name,
    SUM(pv.market_value_amount) AS total_portfolio_value
FROM bank_dwh.fact_portfolio_valuation_daily pv
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_market m
    ON pv.market_key = m.market_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON pv.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
    m.display_name
ORDER BY
    total_portfolio_value DESC;

WITH ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        customer_key,
        business_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY business_id
            ORDER BY effective_from_date DESC, version_number DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
    WHERE is_current = TRUE
)
DELETE FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
WHERE customer_key IN (
    SELECT customer_key
    FROM ranked_customers
    WHERE rn > 1
);

SELECT
    a.account_type_code,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_account a
WHERE a.opened_date >= '2025-01-01'
  AND a.opened_date < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY
    a.account_type_code
ORDER BY
    a.account_type_code;

SELECT
    b.city_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
    ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND d.quarter_number = 1
GROUP BY
    b.city_name
ORDER BY
    b.city_name;

SELECT
  AVG(f.closing_balance_amount) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_balance_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_date = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT
  AVG(f.mid_rate) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM
  bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily f
JOIN
  bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN
  bank_dwh.dim_currency c ON f.currency_key = c.currency_key
WHERE
  c.iso_alpha_code = 'USD'
  AND d.month_number = 12
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025

SELECT
    d.month_number,
    COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY d.month_number
ORDER BY d.month_number;

SELECT
    dc.customer_segment_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dc.customer_key) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer dc
WHERE dc.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY dc.customer_segment_code
ORDER BY dc.customer_segment_code;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_key) AS customer_count_no_transactions_2025
FROM
    bank_dwh.dim_customer c
WHERE
    c.is_current = TRUE
    AND c.is_active = TRUE
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction fat
        JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fat.business_date_key = d.date_key
        WHERE fat.customer_key = c.customer_key
          AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025
    );

SELECT
    COALESCE(
        SUM(CASE WHEN fa.payment_status_code = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        0
    ) AS declined_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization fa
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON fa.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025

SELECT
    c.display_name AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category c
    ON f.complaint_category_key = c.complaint_category_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE c.is_current = TRUE
  AND c.is_active = TRUE
  AND f.is_escalated = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
    c.display_name
ORDER BY
    escalated_complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
    c.display_name AS channel_name,
    SUM(f.fee_amount) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel c
    ON f.channel_key = c.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.posting_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
    c.display_name
ORDER BY
    total_fees DESC;

SELECT
  SUM(fd.transaction_amount) AS total_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute fd
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON fd.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE fd.dispute_reason_code = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025

SELECT
    j.display_name AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction j
    ON f.jurisdiction_key = j.jurisdiction_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE f.alert_severity_code = 'HIGH'
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
    j.display_name
ORDER BY
    alert_count DESC;

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM
    bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS d
JOIN
    bank_dwh.dim_date AS dt
    ON d.business_date_key = dt.date_key
WHERE
    dt.calendar_date = DATE '2025-08-31'
    AND d.days_past_due > 90

SELECT
    d.calendar_year_number AS transaction_year,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel c
    ON f.channel_key = c.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE c.display_name = 'Mobile App'
    AND d.calendar_year_number IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY
    d.calendar_year_number
ORDER BY
    d.calendar_year_number;

SELECT
    lp.display_name AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(fld.outstanding_principal_amount) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_disbursement fld
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_loan_product lp
    ON fld.loan_product_key = lp.loan_product_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON fld.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY
    lp.display_name
ORDER BY
    total_outstanding_principal DESC;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_key) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer c
    ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE c.customer_segment_code = 'SME'
    AND f.is_cross_border = TRUE
    AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025

WITH branch_atm_counts AS (
    SELECT
        b.region_code,
        b.display_name AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
        ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
        ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
    GROUP BY
        b.region_code,
        b.display_name
),
ranked_branches AS (
    SELECT
        region_code,
        branch_name,
        atm_transaction_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY region_code
            ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC
        ) as rn
    FROM branch_atm_counts
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_transaction_count
FROM ranked_branches
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT
    c.business_id,
    SUM(w.original_amount) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer w
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer c
    ON w.customer_key = c.customer_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON w.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY c.business_id
ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    ft.currency_code,
    SUM(ft.original_amount) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer ft
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON ft.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
    ft.currency_code
ORDER BY
    total_wire_transfer_amount DESC;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT wt.customer_key) AS distinct_customers
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer wt
INNER JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d_wt
  ON wt.business_date_key = d_wt.date_key
INNER JOIN bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction atm
  ON wt.customer_key = atm.customer_key
INNER JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d_atm
  ON atm.business_date_key = d_atm.date_key
WHERE d_wt.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND d_atm.calendar_year_number = 2025

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM
    bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fwt
JOIN
    bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON fwt.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE
    d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT
    d.calendar_year_number AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.calendar_year_number
ORDER BY d.calendar_year_number;

SELECT
    dc.customer_segment_code,
    AVG(dc.estimated_assets_amount) AS avg_customer_lifetime_value
FROM
    bank_dwh.dim_customer dc
WHERE
    dc.is_current = TRUE
    AND dc.estimated_assets_amount IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    dc.customer_segment_code;

SELECT
  c.gender_code,
  COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer c
WHERE c.is_current = TRUE
  AND c.gender_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.gender_code
ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

WITH ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        customer_key,
        business_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY business_id
            ORDER BY effective_from_date DESC, version_number DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
)
DELETE FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
WHERE customer_key IN (
    SELECT customer_key
    FROM ranked_customers
    WHERE rn > 1
);
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bank_dwh.fact_complaint CASCADE;

INSERT INTO bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily (
    business_date_key,
    currency_code,
    quote_currency_code,
    mid_rate,
    source_system_code,
    source_record_id,
    ingested_at,
    updated_at,
    record_hash,
    data_quality_status_code,
    load_batch_id,
    event_id,
    event_status_code
) VALUES (
    (SELECT date_key FROM bank_dwh.dim_date WHERE calendar_date = '2025-12-31'),
    'USD',
    'USD',
    1.10,
    'POC',
    'POC_INSERT_20251231',
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    md5('POC_INSERT_20251231'),
    'VALID',
    'POC_BATCH_001',
    'POC_EVENT_001',
    'SUCCESS'
);

UPDATE bank_dwh.dim_customer
SET customer_segment_code = 'AFFLUENT'
WHERE city_name = 'Cluj-Napoca'
  AND is_current = TRUE;

SELECT
    c.iso_alpha_code AS currency_code,
    SUM(wt.original_amount) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer wt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency c
    ON wt.currency_key = c.currency_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON wt.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
    c.iso_alpha_code
ORDER BY
    total_wire_transfer_volume DESC;

SELECT
    dc.display_name AS channel_name,
    COUNT(fat.account_transaction_fact_key) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction fat
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel dc
    ON fat.channel_key = dc.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON fat.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY dc.display_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dc.business_id) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer dc
WHERE dc.is_current = TRUE
  AND dc.is_active = TRUE;

SELECT
    j.display_name AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction j
    ON f.jurisdiction_key = j.jurisdiction_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY j.display_name
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT
    b.display_name AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
    ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
    b.display_name
ORDER BY
    transaction_count DESC;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute AS fcd
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS dd
  ON fcd.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.business_id) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.business_date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer AS c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key
WHERE f.default_flag = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_date = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_day.calendar_date)
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS snapshot_fact
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS snapshot_day ON snapshot_day.date_key = snapshot_fact.business_date_key
    WHERE snapshot_day.calendar_year_number = 2025
      AND snapshot_day.month_number = 8
  );

SELECT
  dcc.display_name AS complaint_category,
  COUNT(fc.complaint_fact_key) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category dcc
  ON fc.complaint_category_key = dcc.complaint_category_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON fc.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
  dcc.display_name
ORDER BY
  complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
    c.iso_alpha_code AS currency_code,
    d.calendar_year_number,
    d.month_number,
    AVG(f.mid_rate) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency c
    ON f.currency_key = c.currency_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
    AND f.mid_rate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    c.iso_alpha_code,
    d.calendar_year_number,
    d.month_number
ORDER BY
    c.iso_alpha_code,
    d.calendar_year_number,
    d.month_number;

SELECT
    m.display_name AS market_name,
    SUM(f.market_value_amount) AS total_portfolio_value
FROM bank_dwh.fact_portfolio_valuation_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_market m
    ON f.market_key = m.market_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
    m.display_name
ORDER BY
    total_portfolio_value DESC;

WITH ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        customer_key,
        business_id,
        business_code,
        display_name,
        description,
        effective_from_date,
        effective_to_date,
        is_current,
        is_active,
        source_system_code,
        source_record_id,
        ingested_at,
        updated_at,
        record_hash,
        data_quality_status_code,
        data_owner_code,
        version_number,
        legal_name,
        given_name,
        family_name,
        preferred_name,
        birth_date,
        incorporation_date,
        national_id_hash,
        tax_id_hash,
        customer_segment_code,
        customer_subsegment_code,
        relationship_manager_id,
        residence_country_code,
        tax_residency_country_code,
        city_name,
        postal_code,
        address_line_1,
        address_line_2,
        email_hash,
        phone_hash,
        occupation_code,
        industry_code,
        employer_name,
        kyc_status_code,
        kyc_review_date,
        pep_status_code,
        sanctions_status_code,
        risk_band_code,
        onboarding_date,
        closure_date,
        preferred_language_code,
        preferred_contact_channel_code,
        marketing_consent_flag,
        privacy_consent_flag,
        household_size_count,
        annual_income_amount,
        estimated_assets_amount,
        source_of_wealth_code,
        customer_since_date,
        deceased_flag,
        vulnerability_code,
        customer_classification_code,
        customer_status_code,
        customer_risk_band_code,
        customer_family_code,
        customer_owner_code,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY business_id
            ORDER BY effective_from_date DESC, version_number DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
)
DELETE FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
WHERE customer_key IN (
    SELECT customer_key
    FROM ranked_customers
    WHERE rn > 1
);

SELECT
    a.account_type_code,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_account a
WHERE a.opened_date >= '2025-01-01'
  AND a.opened_date < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY
    a.account_type_code
ORDER BY
    a.account_type_code;

SELECT
    b.city_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
    ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND d.quarter_number = 1
GROUP BY
    b.city_name
ORDER BY
    b.city_name;

SELECT
  AVG(f.closing_balance_amount) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_balance_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_date = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT
  AVG(f.mid_rate) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM
  bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily f
JOIN
  bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN
  bank_dwh.dim_currency c ON f.currency_key = c.currency_key
WHERE
  c.iso_alpha_code = 'USD'
  AND d.month_number = 12
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025

SELECT
    d.month_number,
    COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY d.month_number
ORDER BY d.month_number;

SELECT
    dc.customer_segment_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dc.customer_key) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer dc
WHERE dc.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY dc.customer_segment_code
ORDER BY dc.customer_segment_code;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_key)
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer c
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction fat
    ON c.customer_key = fat.customer_key
    AND fat.posting_date_key IN (
        SELECT d.date_key
        FROM bank_dwh.dim_date d
        WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
    )
WHERE c.is_current = TRUE
  AND fat.account_transaction_fact_key IS NULL;

SELECT
    COALESCE(
        SUM(CASE WHEN fa.payment_status_code = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        0
    ) AS declined_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization fa
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
